entities.name: Shadress
entities.description: A human tailor from New Capenna, Elnor's girlfriend and informal leader and moral compass of Yuma and Elnor's gang; implied to have died.

entities.name: Yuma
entities.description: Member of the gang who reflected on Elnor's changed fighting style.

entities.name: Elnor
entities.description: Shadress's boyfriend in the gang, whose calm fighting style honors her.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: Labor gang the friends had been part of.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: Family controlling the train in the failed robbery.

events.summary: Shadress proposes buying a building; the debt drives the group into crime.
events.quote: The debt they incurred led them into a spiral of crime

events.summary: A failed robbery on a Brokers-controlled train leaves the group poor and splintering.
events.quote: A failed robbery on a Brokers -controlled train left the group poor and splintering.

events.summary: Shadress is implied to have died, inferred from Elnor's changed fighting style.
events.quote: it's implied that she died sometime after the train heist
